name: kamalainfra-digital-platform
description: Kamala Infra — trust-first PropTech platform for the Telangana residential market

scripts.infra:reset: docker compose down -v && docker compose up -d
scripts.// test setup: Creates .env.test and the *_test database. Safe to re-run.
scripts.test:setup: npm run test:env && npm run test:db
scripts.// test: Schema is brought up to date first, so a new migration cannot make the suite fail for the wrong reason
scripts.test: npm run test:db && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.// build order: @kamala/db must be compiled before anything that imports it
scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @kamala/db && npm run build --workspace @kamala/api
